source: &10 WHAT THE HELL did you think you were DOING?! We NEED her ALIVE!
target: &10 你到底以为自己在干什么？！我们要她活着！

source: &108 I saw an opportunity - for striking back at Regis.
target: &108 我看到了一个机会，可以报复里吉斯。

source: &11 At REGIS?! You've never even met the man!
target: &11 报复里吉斯？！你连他本人都没见过！

source: &12 You haven't offloaded Baxter yet, have you?
target: &12 你还没卸载巴克斯特，对吧？

source: &13 Look, there might just be a use for your newfound vendetta.
target: &13 听着，你这股新冒出来的仇恨，也许还能派上用场。

source: &14 The tap on his partner was successful. She found where Regis is hiding.
target: &14 对他搭档的监听成功了。她找到了里吉斯的藏身处。

source: &15 He's an unfactored element. NOW he needs to be removed from the equation.
target: &15 他是个计划之外的变数。现在必须把他排除。

source: &112 Don't worry - I'll kill him myself, if it comes to it.
target: &112 别担心，真有必要，我会亲手杀了他。

source: &16 There's only so much of the city's resources that can be diverted to this.
target: &16 我们能为这件事调用的城市资源是有限的。

source: &17 Find him, finish him, then return for offloading.
target: &17 找到他，干掉他，然后回来卸载。

source: &18 Remember - I'M your controller, not Baxter.
target: &18 记住，我才是你的控制者，不是巴克斯特。
